Could this be authored in Encounter?

Yes: named queries, nested statements, expressions and explicit port calls already form a structured language. JSON is the current encoding, not a lack of language structure.

The existing readable process compiler pilot covers let, when and port, with a bounded operator set. This module also needs fold, assert, call and try/catch; it uses additional operators and dotted references. The Encounter view/representation dialect is another frontend and does not accept this whole module.

The route to authoring is to extend the existing algebra-owned process frontend, then check exact JSON structure, lowering, results, faults and effect order. Only after those correspondence checks should a declared source-owner switch make readable text authoritative. This page performs no such switch.
